column1: # TEST FIXTURE ONLY -- the retail `vz` transit landing pads (the `LandingZone` COMP), extracted.
# NOT A GAME ASSET PATH. The loader that reads this file is `#[cfg(test)]`, so it cannot be compiled
# into the shipping game at all. The game reads these pads from the player's own vz.wad
# (`worldutil::landing_zone_pads`, called from `mercs2_game::world`) and this file is never consulted
# there. Nothing here makes the game playable without owning it, and nothing here may ever be wired
# into a runtime path -- if you find yourself wanting to, read the WAD instead.
# WHY IT EXISTS. `Pg.GetAllLandingZones(nSlot)` answers from WORLD DATA, not from Lua. The shipped
# corpus holds only REFERENCES to these pads -- a zone number (`nLandingZone = 12`,
# `vz/wifhqdata.lua:126`) or a name to resolve (`sParkingLot = "12_chi_hq_lz_playerone"`, `:128`) --
# so a test host with the Lua corpus but no archive cannot produce them. `MrxTransit.Reset` then
# bails on the empty list, leaves `_tLandingZones = false`, and the shipped `SaveSingleton` (which
# iterates it with none of the `if not _tLandingZones` guards its siblings carry) is a hard error.
# PROVENANCE. Every row is measured, not authored: `worldutil::landing_zone_pads()` over the retail
# `layers_static` block of vz.wad. 46 records = 23 zones x 2 co-op player slots. The zone set
# `1..8, 12, 15..18, 20..25, 27..30` is corroborated independently by the vendored save fixtures'
# `tTransitData` and by a live capture of retail play (see
# `retail_capture_corroborates_the_authored_landing_zone_set`). `landing_zone_pads_match_the_vendored_table`
# re-derives this file from the WAD and fails on any drift, so it cannot silently rot.
# Zone 12 slot 1 has an empty name: it ships with a `LandingZone` record and a `Transform` but no
# `Name` COMP. Reproduced, not repaired -- it is why the COMP, and not the name convention, is the
# enumeration authority. Zone 3 slot 1's `..._llz_playerone` is likewise a retail typo, kept.
# Columns, tab-separated: zone  slot  key  name  x  y  z
